text:
Staff Site Reliability Engineer at GlobalRetail Inc. with 12 years of experience shaping scalable, resilient systems in the e-commerce sector. Passionate about building infrastructure that empowers teams to innovate without compromising reliability.  

My work centers on designing and maintaining cloud-native architectures on AWS, automating workflows through CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring systems run smoothly with Linux at their core. I thrive at the intersection of infrastructure and operations, leveraging tools like Prometheus and Grafana to turn raw data into actionable insights. Terraform has become a cornerstone for streamlining deployments and maintaining consistency across environments.  

Collaboration is key—mentoring peers, sharing best practices, and driving cross-team initiatives to align engineering and operations. I’m driven by solving complex challenges and creating systems that scale with business growth.  

When I’m not coding, you’ll find me exploring ways to simplify operations, optimize costs, and make infrastructure work smarter—not harder. Let’s build better systems, together.
